title: Allow specify protection/security levels upon requesting a device
body:
Some devices require higher levels of security in pairing before accessing their GATT characteristics. For example, when the [battery level example](https://googlechrome.github.io/samples/web-bluetooth/battery-level.html) is tested on an iPhone SE running iOS 13.3 (advertising the battery service using the [nRF Connect](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nrf-connect/id1054362403) app), and a computer running Chromium 83.0.4086.0 on Windows 10 18363.720, the user receives `SecurityError: GATT operation not authorized.`. On Windows, UWP implements [several different protection levels](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/uwp/api/windows.devices.enumeration.devicepairingprotectionlevel) that can be used for Bluetooth pairing, including the `EncryptionAndAuthentication` pairing mode, which presents a code on both devices that the user needs to verify is the same, which appears to be required for accessing many GATT characteristics on iOS.

I believe it would be helpful to have the ability to set a pairing protection level when requesting access to a device with `navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice`. Thoughts?
